title: I made one of my dreams games and can't stop playing it. If anyone else likes this kind of thing, here it is.
author: befuddlebug
selftext:
I love tedious, brutal survival games, and for just over two decades I've had a game in my head where you drive a giant block of wood with enormous wooden wheels through an endless desert, powered by a steam engine. I've constructed an elaborate story over the years about all of this, and a couple of times I've tried building the game, only to run into various roadblocks along the way. So as time went on, the lore got deeper and the game got less finished. So now here we are. Opus made everything work, and now I have my game, and I honestly can't stop playing it. I will keep adding more, but if anybody is into these kinds of games, someone else might enjoy it right now.

The basic idea here is that you are on an alien planet far in the future, long after humans colonized and destroyed this world. There were giant trees on the planet, and after everything collapsed, people used the wood to build things. Since the people left there were mostly laborers and not scientists, most of the high tech knowledge was lost. They started using the giant blocks left over from tree processing to make mobile bases called "rollsteads" to move across the landscape. The problem is that they are steam-powered, and there isn't much water. There also isn't much wood, which creates repair problems and keeps them from burning it for heat. Luckily, crystals grow on this planet that give off a good amount of heat, and these can be used to heat the furnace.

The ground is full of dangerous predators, the air is dusty, and the planet's sun is harsh. Chug slowly along to find caves, shrines, cities, and info about the lore if you want to find it. You're seriously not moving fast here. It's a moving base.

comments.author: geddy
comments.body:
Sounds interesting, I will give it a shot. The first thing I noticed was that once you assume FPV, if you go stand on the ledge of the steam engine, your character keeps bouncing up and down. Little buggy things like this, I'll be honest, points to a lack of polish. Just being honest here. 

I'll still keep playing though and check it out some more.

replies.author: befuddlebug
replies.body: I'll see if I can get that fixed.

replies.author: DGRAHAM93
replies.body: He said it’s still being developed lol why would it be a polished finished project while still in development? I see comments like this every single time a game is released while in development and I never understand it…

replies.author: geddy
replies.body: It’s the first thing I noticed within 10 seconds of playing. Would it be better if I didn’t point out a bug?

replies.author: DGRAHAM93
replies.body: I’m not referring to you pointing out a bug, I’m referring to the “points to a lack of polish” comment lol. Like yeah, an unfinished game will usually play like an unfinished game, mind blowing 🤣

replies.author: geddy
replies.body: Ok, ok, fair point. I was pointing that out so OP was aware that small bugs like that could put someone off from playing. Didn't mean to sound like I was pooping on OP. I actually really like his idea.

comments.author: grin_ferno
comments.body: This type of thing makes me smile, and it's EXACTLY why I love AI game dev! You can spend a very small amount of time making something that's really fun. At least for YOU.

replies.author: befuddlebug
replies.body: I was excited to play and all that, but I didn't expect to get so into it. It's kind of crazy.

comments.author: Equivalent-Back-291
comments.body: I didn't read your game but i do know the feeling of playing my first game, played it 60 hours betatesting it for 2 weeks❤️

comments.body: I played it for a little bit, I was entertained.  Thanks for burning some tokens on this.  =)

replies.author: befuddlebug
replies.body: Thanks for burning some time on it :D

comments.author: insteadoflattes
comments.body: Ahhhh that old temptress of a game. She gets us all in the end. Jk super cool and novel concept.

comments.author: Fit-Secretary2495
comments.body: Future era Oregon trail? I can get with it

comments.author: Beskull
comments.body:
This was really the game of your dreams? 

Why is that the only thread title I see lately?

I'm sure your dreams could make this better ...

Still, good job. Hope you find and audience

replies.author: befuddlebug
replies.body:
Yes, it was. I have had three games I've wanted to make over the years that I could never make work the way I wanted. This is one of them. I've put the others together recently too, and I love it. I'm also not looking for an audience. I'm not selling anything here. It's just a game I thought was fun. 

And I'm guessing that everyone is saying they are making their dream games lately because they are. Ai is allowing us to do that. Go make yours.

replies.author: Beskull
replies.body: Sweet. Crazy how powerful this is now. Happy you made a game you love!
